title: Minimum Cost to Connect Ropes
statement:
You have N ropes with given lengths. To connect two ropes into one, the cost equals the sum of their lengths. Connect all ropes into one rope with minimum total cost.

This is a classic greedy problem solved optimally with a min-heap: always connect the two shortest ropes first.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N space-separated integers (rope lengths).
outputFormat: A single integer: the minimum total cost to connect all ropes.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
lengths = list(map(int, input().split()))
